addSeries.title: Add a series
addSeries.subtitle: Tell UltraTorrent you want a show. It provisions everything — the watchlist, the acquisition rule, the download folder, and the back-catalogue search.

search.label: Search for a series
search.placeholder: Title, or paste an IMDb / TMDB id
search.empty: No matches. Try a different title, or paste an IMDb (tt…) or TMDB id.

backfill_and_monitor.name: Backfill and monitor
backfill_and_monitor.description: Get everything that already aired, and keep watching for new episodes.

backfill_only.name: Backfill only
backfill_only.description: Get the back catalogue now, then stop — no ongoing monitoring.

monitor_new_only.name: Monitor new only
monitor_new_only.description: Only new episodes from now on. Nothing that already aired is fetched.

seasons.label: Seasons (optional)
seasons.placeholder: e.g. 1, 2, 3 — leave blank for all seasons
seasons.hint: Limit acquisition to specific seasons. Episodes outside your selection are not wanted (distinct from missing).

plan.title: Readiness
plan.willMonitor: Will keep the acquisition rule enabled for new releases.
plan.existingNew: Not yet on your watchlist — a new entry will be created.
plan.existingLinked: Already on your watchlist ({{status}}) — it will be linked, not duplicated.

inactive.warning: This show has ended or been canceled. Monitoring it for new releases may never produce anything.
inactive.confirm: Yes, monitor this ended show anyway.
inactive.needsPermission: Monitoring an ended show requires the override permission. Ask an administrator.

provision.successExisting: Linked "{{title}}" — it was already on your watchlist.

result.title: Done
result.none: No missing episodes — you are up to date.
result.monitoring: Monitoring is on for new releases.

backfill.title: Back-catalogue search
backfill.none: No backfill has run for this series.
